calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY p.sku
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT sold.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, sold.units, sold.n_lines, sold.n_distinct_lines, sold.staff_units, COALESCE(ret.returned_units,0) AS returned_units
FROM sold JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = sold.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.sku = sold.sku
ORDER BY sold.units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l) AS n_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
       (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM l) AS units_all,
       (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM l WHERE category='ZZ Test') AS units_test,
       (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
       (SELECT MIN(sale_date)||' '||MAX(sale_date) FROM l) AS date_range,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM l) AS days
